# Transaction Aggregations: Aggregate income data for a given time period

Area overview and notes: [transaction-aggregations.md](../transaction-aggregations.md)

`GET /accounts/{id}/income` · tenant-scoped token

Retrieve a summary of total income earned by a specific account using Account ID.

**Path parameters**

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `id` | Your system's unique identifier for the Account. |

**Query parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `start_date` | string (date-time) | No | Only aggregate income transactions from this date-time and later (inclusive). This date cannot be earlier than Jan 1 of the previous year in UTC (for example, 2023-01-01T00:00:00.000Z if it is currently any time in 2024). Use the ISO-8601 date-time format. Defaults to Jan 1 of the current year. |
| `end_date` | string (date-time) | No | Only aggregate income transactions from before this date-time (exclusive). This date must be after start_date. Use the ISO-8601 date-time format. Defaults to the current time in UTC. |
| `roll_up` | string | No | If provided, provides income aggregations rolled up into either month or year intervals. Only intervals with income transactions are returned. If not provided, no roll ups are returned. One of: `year`, `y`, `month`, `m`. |

**Response 200**: Fetching income aggregation was successful

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `data` | object | No |  |
| `data.totals` | object | No | Aggregations of Income Transactions for the requested time period. |
| `data.totals.transaction_count` | integer | No | Total number of income transactions. |
| `data.totals.income` | string (decimal) | No | Total amount of income earned, in USD. |
| `data.totals.fees` | string (decimal) | No | Total amount of fees paid on income transactions, in USD. |
| `data.rollups` | array of object | No | Sparse array of yearly/monthly rollups. |
| `data.rollups[].transaction_count` | integer | No | Total number of income transactions. |
| `data.rollups[].income` | string (decimal) | No | Total amount of income earned, in the fiat currency used to express rates for the account. |
| `data.rollups[].fees` | string (decimal) | No | Total amount of fees paid on income transactions, in the fiat currency used to express rates for the account. |
| `data.rollups[].start_date` | string (date-time) | No | The start date of the month/year rollup in UTC, inclusive. |
| `data.rollups[].end_date` | string (date-time) | No | The end date of the month/year rollup in UTC, exclusive (may be in the future) |

**Errors:** 400 Bad Request · 403 Forbidden · 404 Not Found · 429 Too Many Requests
